title: Sugarcane farmers continue protest in Bagalkot

ai.summary: Sugarcane farmers in Bagalkot district continue protesting for higher prices, demanding ₹4,200-4,250 per tonne based on Maharashtra's package, while some factories in Belagavi have offered prices above the agreed sum.

facts.claim: Sugarcane farmers in Bagalkot district continue protesting for higher prices
facts.quote: While most of the sugar factories in Belagavi district have begun crushing operations, some sugarcane farmers in Bagalkot district are continuing their protest for higher prices.

facts.claim: Farmers demand ₹4,200-4,250 per tonne based on Maharashtra's package
facts.quote: He said that the farmers will not budge till they are assured prices of ₹4,200 to ₹4,250 per tonne of sugarcane.

facts.claim: Some factories in Belagavi have offered prices above the agreed sum
facts.quote: Meanwhile, some sugar factories in Belagavi have offered prices higher than the agreed sum.

ai.background_note: Farmers in north Karnataka have been protesting since 2025 over lower prices, with the state offering ₹3,300 per tonne versus their demand of ₹3,500.
